scope: Fixed-spacing discrete five-point Dirichlet Helmholtz sufficient bounds. Changing shape changes physical domain size; this is not a fixed-domain convergence study. No success is inferred for real field data, PML, time-domain physics, or arbitrary OOD geology.
failure_behavior: zero is unavailable; deployment must use explicit exact fallback or abstain
roundoff_semantics: ordinary floating point with downward allowance; not interval arithmetic
